summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC, an Irish foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K on October 14, 2026, containing its interim financial results for the six months ended June 30, 2026, along with highlights and fiscal 2026 guidance. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, advisor or board recommendation is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings release accompanied by forward-looking statements, not a special situation, and maps to a US domestic issuer's Form 8-K earnings disclosure. Watch for execution on guidance and subsidiary contributions rather than deal mechanics.
